headline: US-Iran Conflict Nears Strait of Hormuz Blockade, Threatening Global Semiconductor Supply
summary: The escalating US-Iran conflict, now in its third week, poses an imminent threat of a Strait of Hormuz blockade, potentially crippling Taiwan's critical semiconductor industry within days. This would trigger a severe global supply chain disruption for chips, impacting AI infrastructure, technology manufacturing, and geopolitical stability.
